title: Phenotypic heterogeneity optimizes trade-offs during adaptive deployment of the type VI secretion system
experiments_summary: 1. Fluorescence microscopy using translational fusions (TssB-sfGFP and TssC-GFP-TssK reporter strains) to visualize T6SS sheath dynamics and transcriptional heterogeneity in EAEC grown in iron-limiting SIM medium versus iron-rich LB medium. Single-cell fluorescence was quantified using MicrobeJ after segmentation with MiSiC; coefficient of variation (CV) was used as a heterogeneity metric. 2. Flow cytometry and fluorescence-activated cell sorting (FACS) on an Influx v7 Cell Sorter to quantify ON/OFF subpopulation ratios and sort subpopulations for downstream assays. 3. Single-cell time-lapse microfluidics using an Ibidi sticky-Slide VI 0.4 with agarose pads, imaging individual founder cells and resulting microcolonies after 7-10 generations to assess inheritance and stability of ON/OFF states. 4. Chromosomal point mutations disrupting individual Fur boxes (F1, F2) or GATC Dam methylation sites (G1, G2, G3, and triple G123 mutant) via site-directed mutagenesis and allelic exchange using pKO3 vector, followed by fluorescence microscopy and FACS to assess effects on ON/OFF ratios and T6SS sheath formation. 5. Intra-species competition assays (LAGA and SGK assays) on SIM agar using EAEC derivatives as attackers and E. coli W3110 KanR as recipients at defined attacker:recipient ratios (4:1 for LAGA, 1:4 for SGK), measuring killing efficiency and survivor growth kinetics. 6. Growth assays in liquid culture (LB and SIM with or without bile salts) comparing WT, F2 (homogeneous ON), and G123 (homogeneous OFF) strains to assess metabolic burden of T6SS assembly. 7. Kin killing experiments using SGK assay to test whether ON cells kill OFF (G123) EAEC cells, comparing susceptibility of Δsci1 mutant, WT, G123, and F2 strains. 8. Galleria mellonella infection model: larvae infected by ingestion of 2×10^5 CFU/mL of EAEC WT, F2 (ON), or G123 (OFF) strains; internal organs homogenized after 24 h and plated on selective LB agar for bacterial recovery. 9. Inter-species competition assays (SGK) between EAEC derivatives and Pseudomonas aeruginosa PAO1ΔretS on SIM agar, with defined F2(ON)/G123(OFF) ratio mixes (0-100%) to quantify the relationship between ON fraction and killing versus susceptibility to retaliation. 10. Three-species competition assays with EAEC (or Δsci1 derivative), PAO1ΔretS (or ΔH1-T6SS derivative), and E. coli W3110, mixed 1:1:1 and co-incubated on SIM agar for 4 h, with survival quantified by selective plating using strain-specific antibiotic markers. 11. Pfur transcriptional reporter assays by fluorescence microscopy to determine whether heterogeneous fur expression underlies T6SS heterogeneity. All experiments were performed with at least three independent biological replicates; statistical analyses used Student's t-tests, Wilcoxon tests, and one-way ANOVA with Tukey's post-hoc test.
